name: fig_proof_graph
title: Proof dependency graph of the trusted Lean core
question: Which executable definitions and which specifications does each audited theorem talk about, and how do the proofs build on each other?
model: Directed graph extracted statically from the elaborated Lean environment: an edge T->D is drawn solid when D occurs in the statement (type) of T and thin when D occurs only in its proof term or definition body (direct valueDeps restricted to the drawn nodes). Columns follow the module structure; order within a column minimises crossings (barycentre heuristic).
data: docs/forensics/cryolean-forensics.json (839 declarations, for-all-dev/forensics extractor); nodes = the 44 theorems in lean/audit-axioms.json + 52 key definitions; 82 statement edges, 195 direct proof/definition edges (395 if followed through undrawn helper lemmas). Data: paper/data/fig_proof_graph.json.
caption: Dependency structure of CryoLean's trusted Lean 4 core: the 44 axiom-audited theorems (circles) and 52 definitions they build on (squares), coloured by module. Solid edges are statement dependencies, thin grey edges direct proof or definitional dependencies; both are extracted from the elaborated environment by the forensics tool, not drawn by hand. The soundness theorems connect the executable checker (Checker) to an independent specification (Spec: AcceptSpec, RejectSpec), and the schedule theorems reuse the verdict. Bold labels mark headline theorems.
